batch: First-Interaction Anchored Spatial Transport Feasibility and Transfer
part_A_note: Part A (Stage 0 contract + Stage 1 physical gate) is frozen and run before the Stage 2 candidate is designed; Part B (candidate, training, gates, confirmation) is appended and frozen before any candidate fitting or Stage 4 reference.

stage0.medium: p53_fixtures: sigma_t 1000 /m (mfp 1 mm), albedo (0.999, 0.99, 0.9), isotropic phase g = 0, index-matched boundary, 2.5 mm ports, 16 incoming / 64 outgoing equal-projected-solid-angle bins (concentric mapping), unit-flux cell sources (uniform on the port, cosine-weighted in the bin)
stage0.contract: K(i,a->j,o) = B + K_scat; K_scat = (1 - beta(i,a)) E_{x ~ p1(.|i,a)} Q(x -> j,o); p1: entry point uniform on port i, direction cosine-weighted in bin a, chord t, first-collision probability c = 1 - exp(-sigma t), collision distance truncated exponential on [0,t) (so 1 - beta(i,a) = E[c] exactly, the zero-collision complement of the existing ballistic B); Q(x) = albedo [E1(x) + M(x)], E1 = isotropic emission at x escaping without further collision (exact, geometry-only), M = orders >= 2
stage0.independence: Q depends on x and the current geometry only: the walk is Markov and the phase function is isotropic, so the post-collision direction is independent of the incident direction; holds for this medium only
non_generalising: anisotropic phase (g != 0): Q depends on the incident direction at x
surface / BSDF scattering: the first interaction is on the boundary with a frame- and direction-dependent redirection
index-mismatched boundaries (Fresnel / internal reflection): exits are not unconditional
heterogeneous media: p1 is no longer a single exponential and Q is not translation-structured
stage0.energy: sum_{j,o} E1 <= 1, sum Q <= albedo, sum K_scat <= 1 - beta: passive for any learned M with sum_{j,o} M(x) <= 1 - sum E1(x)

stage1.purpose: verify the first-interaction decomposition against the established first-exit references (validation estimators only; never inference)
stage1.estimators: phys76.decomposed (forced first collision, isotropic restart, exact next segment, then the UNCHANGED p53_tracer.walk); phys76.single_quadrature (expected-value E1 composition); forward negative control (restart along the incident direction)
stage1.references: archived WL73 / WL71 first-exit bundles on LabServer63 (unchanged WL57 walker, independent seeds): K replicas of collided S and zero-collision B16
stage1.seeds: 761000000 + g*1e6 + slot*1e4 + bin*100 + rep (g: rest 0, pt0 1, te0 2; rep 0 main, 1 control); single quadrature 762...

rules.text: every packet: |energy z| <= 4 per channel and 0.5 <= coarse-cell mean z^2 <= 1.5 (over coarse cells whose expected event count N x mean >= 30, the mean taken from the INDEPENDENT estimator - the reference, or the quadrature for the single-scatter test - never from the tested estimator; at least 30 such cells) for decomposed total vs reference and for the single-scatter quadrature vs the MC single tally; first-collision probability E[c] vs 1 - beta from the reference B16 within |z| <= 4 (reference SE = max(replica SE, binomial sqrt(beta (1-beta) / (K x 32M)))); leaks + wrong-side <= 320 (1e-5 N), no truncation; the forward control must be REJECTED in every control packet (test power). Any failure: STOP and report.

stage1.pre_freeze_note: local reduced-photon smoke (non-evidence, 200k photons) showed the coarse z^2 statistic inflated by 0-hit cells (self-comparison of two seeds of the same estimator gives z^2 1.0 / 0.95) and a 0 replica SE when no ballistic exit occurs; both fixed before freezing; selecting cells by the tested estimator's own hit counts inflated z^2 (~2) and was replaced by selection on the independent estimate; 2M-photon smoke after the fix: total vs reference z^2 0.92-1.15, single quadrature vs MC 0.58-1.52 (one 1.52 at ~10 expected events per cell), forward control rejected 4/4 (z^2 2,600-9,100); min expected events raised to 30 before freezing

amendments.user_decision: 「사후 amendment로 진행」 (answer to the Stage 1 FAIL question)
amendments.evidence_seen: Stage 1 results (stage1/physics.json sha256 e74fc360...): gate FAIL with one failure - rest_s70_a0 single-scatter quadrature vs MC single tally, coarse mean z^2 1.703 > 1.5 (energy z 0.09); every other check passed: decomposed vs reference 36/36 (z^2 0.90-1.13), first-collision probability 36/36, forward control rejected 4/4; the single-quadrature statistic over 36 packets ranged 0.60-1.70
amendments.diagnostic: NON-EVIDENCE re-test of the failing packet with three fresh seed pairs (diag/diag_s70.py, LabServer63, N 32M each, seeds 769000011-13 / 769100011-13): z^2 0.936 / 1.106 / 0.762, cells 126, energy |z| <= 1.11 (diag/diag_s70_nonevidence.json sha256 5e11ab0f...)
amendments.change: Stage 1 is treated as passed for the purpose of proceeding: the single failing self-consistency check is replaced by the fresh-seed re-test (all three within the original 0.5-1.5 band). The original Stage 1 verdict (FAIL by the frozen rule) is preserved and reported; this is a post hoc decision taken after seeing Stage 1 evidence, labelled as such.

amendments.reason: dev smoke (non-evidence) Stage 3 ran out of GPU memory (12 GB) while building the full-geometry FIA runtime at q = 1024: every per-port quadrature row was kept uncoalesced and concatenated
amendments.change: fia76.quadrature sums duplicate (cell, anchor) and (cell, exit port/bin) entries immediately (float64 sums); the operator is identical. Local check: full rest build peak 3.36 GB, state 1.3 GB (W 59 MB, SS 710 MB, local R 413 MB, tail 127 MB), 49 s; physics passed; tests 7/7

amendments.reason: dev smoke Stage 3 out of GPU memory: the physics rebuild-identity check held two full FIA runtimes at once
amendments.change: eval76.fia_physics keeps one runtime resident at a time (outputs kept, runtime freed before the rebuild); the rebuild identity uses the relative 1e-6 tolerance of test76 (GPU index_add order is not bitwise) instead of exact equality

amendments.reason: dev smoke Stage 3 out of GPU memory in eval76.score: every native prediction (16 x P x 64 x 3) was kept on the GPU

part_B: frozen after Stage 1 completed and amendment 1, before any candidate fit, Stage 3 evaluation or Stage 4 reference. Pre-freeze (non-evidence, local) code fixes found by test76: per-cell rescaling of W + SS to 1 - beta_B (budget consistency with the ballistic B), neighbour ties included in N(k), receiver face id replaced by |n_z| (symmetry invariance)

candidate.name: FIA (first-interaction anchored)
candidate.learned: R_theta only: rho (escape mass), tau (tail share), local / tail spatial softmax with the analytic exp(-r/L_c)/(r^2+1mm^2) prior (L_c learned, init 18.1/5.8/1.8 mm) plus MLP corrections, ring-lobe mixture weights; 6 MLPs (2 hidden layers of 64, SiLU, zero-initialised outputs), 42,565 parameters
candidate.features: anchor: free paths to the boundary along -n, +n and 8 lateral directions (sorted), exp(-d/1mm), depth; receiver: the same from the port (0.25 mm inside) + area ratio, thickness, normal spread, |n_z|; pair: distance/1cm, receiver-normal cosine, normal product, exp(-r/2mm); all invariant to the slab symmetries
candidate.geometry_only_operators: W (cells -> anchors) and SS (cells -> exit port/bin) by fixed-seed quadrature of the current geometry and sigma_t only (per-port seeds 762000000 + 1e7 x geometry index + 16 x port), like the ballistic B; deployable, no reference, no privileged label
candidate.privileged_supervision: none: the candidate trains only on the S16-R collided first-exit targets of the preserved baselines; Stage 1 estimators are validation-only
candidate.material_difference: no learned map from source-port features to spatial transport (W+UV) and no source-receiver relational kernel with a shared incident A (RSK): the incident dependence is entirely geometric (W, SS); the learned part is one source-independent response of an interior isotropic emitter with invariant features and ring lobes; equivariant by construction (no L_sym)
candidate.expected_cost: state: W about P*16*60 nnz, SS up to P*16*1024 nnz before coalescing, local R 4P*512*9 floats (about 280 MB), tail 4P*240*9; apply = 3 sparse products + one scatter over 4P*512 slots

optimizer.objective: WL68 objective J (family68 definition) on the dense prediction, mean over geometries (rest, pt0) of the mean over (source, channel)
optimizer.full_batch: all 16 S16-R sources x 16 bins per step (gradient accumulated over 4-source chunks)

stage3.data: S16-R held-out replicas 4-7 (eval73.load_refs) + WL73 development groups (descriptive); baselines AR_5901/5902 (~/rest_src73/runs) and A75_5901/5902 (~/rest_rank75/runs, copied byte-for-byte from the local WL75 root); labelled G0_r0 / G2_r0 training oracles (WL74 Stage 1 arithmetic)

gate.rule: fit: each FIA seed, every listed group and metric: hi <= 1.25 x max over the AR (rank-8) seeds; validity: runtime physics (zero, positivity, linearity, column sums <= 1, rebuild identity) on rest and pt0; computational: full runtime state <= 4 GiB and 64-light apply <= 10 x the rank-16 baseline in the same process. PHYSICAL VALIDITY FAILURE / INSUFFICIENT FIT / COMPUTATIONAL INFEASIBILITY stop before any Stage 4 reference; GATES PASSED -> Stage 4

stage4.population: ports76.py (geometry only), proposed on the archived rest geometry and RG.geometry(te1) before any WL76 candidate evidence; excludes 81 previously scored ports and all exact images
stage4.references: probes74 code unchanged (WL57 fast walker, gates, 32M, K = 4); seeds 766000000 + g*1e6 + slot*1e4 + bin*100 + rep (rest 0, te1 1); rest: all non-empty slots, te1: footprint 24-27

decision.stronger: per group, the preserved baseline (AR or A75) with the lower mean over its two seeds of con_coarse hi
decision.far_rule: far = YES iff max over FIA seeds of BND_FAR con_coarse hi <= 0.8 x min over the stronger baseline seeds AND < min of their lower 95 % bounds; NO iff min FIA > 0.8 x max stronger; else OVERLAP; near likewise on BND_NEAR
decision.regression_rule: per group/metric vs the better baseline (lower seed mean): YES iff min FIA >= 1.25 x max baseline; NO iff max FIA < 1.25 x min baseline; else OVERLAP
decision.classes: PHYSICAL VALIDITY FAILURE; INCONCLUSIVE (primary unmeasured or far OVERLAP); far YES: TRANSFERABLE BENEFIT (independent far boundary), or TRADE-OFF if a regression is YES; far NO: NO INDEPENDENT BOUNDARY-TRANSFER BENEFIT (+ LOCAL BENEFIT if near YES, + with regression)
decision.absolute_gates: WL59: abs_coarse <= 0.10, abs_fine16 <= 0.15, con_coarse <= 0.25 per group; DEF relative <= 0.35 and corr >= 0.90 (eval73 Qdef); reported separately

stage4.analysis: mechanism: exact single-scatter share of each reference and the error of the learned multiple-scatter part; hi/lo sub-cell pairs; per-source error vs distance; checkpoints; labelled G0/G2 oracles (replica 0 fit, 1-3 score)

execution.chain: Stage 1 (Part A) -> inputs -> tests -> probe -> 2 fits -> Stage 3 + gates -> [references -> bundle -> Stage 4] -> export; one detached setsid chain; any failure stops
execution.lanes_rule: probe both runs concurrently; two lanes iff both complete and the sum of peak reserved memory <= 0.85 x GPU memory, else one lane
execution.dev_smoke: ~/rest_fia76_dev: 30-step fits, 5 oracle iterations, 0.5M photons on dev_slots, Stage 4 forced, no metric used
